enchantments.tooltip: Disable Device +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Disable Device skill.
Dexterity +8: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Attack Bonus +4: Provides a +4 competence bonus to your attack rolls.
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
